name: timeline
description: A horizontal timeline with ordered milestones. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET — compose it with tier-2/3 elements instead: a path element for the horizontal line (e.g. points [[100,375],[900,375]]), an arrow at the end if desired, point-like shape elements (small circles) at evenly spaced x positions for the milestones, and label elements attached to them, alternating side 'above'/'below' to avoid collisions.
